_comment: 'The NEXT attack action card with cost 2 or greater you play this turn gains +4{p}' is a one-shot, not a turn-long continuous: APPLY_CONTINUOUS would buff EVERY qualifying attack for the rest of the turn. The nested CARD_IN_ZONE gate was meaningless too -- it asked whether the HAND held such a card, not whether the attack being made was one. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK carries the filter and is consumed by the first attack that matches.
